batting.dismissal: c RP Singh b Y Venugopal Rao

batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: c LPC Silva b Shahid Afridi

batting.name: AM Nayar
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b RP Singh

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c Shahid Afridi b Y Venugopal Rao

batting.name: AC Gilchrist
batting.dismissal: c PR Shah b CRD Fernando

batting.name: Shahid Afridi
batting.dismissal: c DJ Thornely b DJ Bravo

batting.name: LPC Silva
batting.dismissal: c YV Takawale b AM Nayar

batting.name: Y Venugopal Rao
batting.dismissal: c PR Shah b DJ Bravo

balls.text: RP bowls a full toss angling into the right-hander, Takawale hits the ball towards long-on and calls for two and gets it too
Takawale backs away to make room and RP hits the blockhole outside off stump, not much Takawale can do about it, he gets beaten
full toss angling into the right-hander, Raje drives towards long-off for a single
full delivery in the blockhole outside off stump, excellent ball, Raje tries to get bat on ball but fails

bowled him! RP takes the purple cap from Shane Warne, Shah backs away towards leg to make room to hit over the off side, RP follows him with a full ball and hits leg stump after Shah fails to connect with his swing, RP's now the highest wicket-taker of the tournament
short of a length outside off stump, Shah waits for it and opens the face to chip the ball past the wicketkeeper for four to third man
fuller length on middle and leg stump, flicked off the pads through square leg, Vijaykumar finishes a ten-ball over
Takawale backs away and mis-hits the pull short towards midwicket, the length wasn't short enough
Takawale backs away to make room, Vijaykumar bowls a low full toss, Takawale drives towards long on
full ball angling into middle and leg, Shah tries to flick but misses and gets hit on the pad once again
another wide down leg side, just the two legal balls so far
full and straight this time, it's the 50th free hit of the tournament and only four sixes have been hit of them, Takawale tries to hit through the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pad
now he over-steps and bowls a high full toss that Shah drives towards long-off, horrific over so far
Vijaykumar strays down leg side again, that's another wide, six runs off one ball so far
full toss on leg stump, awful delivery, Shah steps out of his crease and glances the ball off his pads towards the fine leg boundary
Vijaykumar starts his new spell with a wide down leg side

bowled him! Bravo backs away towards leg to make room and hit inside out over cover, RP bowls the full ball homing in on middle stump, Bravo misses and hears the sound of leather and cork hitting wood, RP's struck two vital blows

how has that cleared the fence? Bravo pre-meditated the pull and went through with the shot even though it wasn't short enough, he didn't look very elegant but he's connected superbly and the ball clears the boundary comfortably

caught! Nayar falls at a crucial time, he backs away towards the leg side to make room, RP bowls the ball short and at pace, Nayar tries to pull but mis-hits it high in the air towards point where Rohit Sharma takes a simple catch
fuller length outside off stump, Bravo drills the ball towards long-off with a powerful drive
Nayar backs away towards leg this time and RP follows him with a low full toss, Nayar hits the ball hard to midwicket

lovely shot, terrific, Nayar moves forward and across his stumps and picks a length ball which angles into him and lofts it high and far over long leg for six, he created the angle to hit behidn square by moving across his stumps
Nayar backs away towards leg, Zoysa follows him with a length ball and Nayar nudges it towards point
full ball on middle stump, Bravo comes forward and drives the ball hard towards long-on where Afridi fields on the boundary
Bravo goes inside out and lofts the ball towards deep cover, Zoysa had over-stepped so Bravo has a free hit
that's an ugly slog, Bravo comes down the track and tries to pull towards deep midwicket, his bottom hand comes off the bat as he is beaten by the slower ball
once again Nayar moves across his stumps and uses the angle into him from over the wicket to guide the ball towards fine leg, Gilchirst has pushed the man back to the boundary now
the attempted slower ball ends up as a leg side full toss, Nayar clips it off his pads between the wicketkeeper and short fine leg for four more
clever clever shot, Nayar moves across to a full ball on off stump and scoops the ball past the fielder at short fine leg for four, he knew the fielder was in the circle and cashed in
nudged off the front foot towards the off side for a single

Nayar's slogged it and slogged it out of the ground! He got down on one knee, moved his front foot out of the way and lofted the ball high over midwicket, it didn't look well-timed at first but the ball travelled several rows back
lofted on the first bounce towards long-on for a single
what a ball that is! The googly spits off the pitch back into Bravo who doesn't read it, he gets an inside edge that misses his stumps and runs to the boundary
Bravo moves across and tries to flick but misses and gets hit on the pad
pushed off the front foot towards the vacant mid-on area for two, Afridi runs back to field
Bravo steps out of his crease and drives towards long-off for a single
Nayar moves forward and flicks through midwicket for a single, there's a semi-direct hit at the non-striker's end but Nayar is safe
driven off the front foot towards long off
sublime! Bravo steps out of his crease, gets to the pitch of the ball and flicks it high and far over deep midwicket
Bravo moves back in his crease and plays the ball to midwicket, Nayar wants the single but Bravo sends him back
Nayar makes room and hits towards long-off for a single

superb placement and timing! Bravo stays in his crease, waits for the ball to reach him outside off and drives powerfully through extra cover, there's a fielder at long off but he can't run across quickly enough
Nayar steps out of his crease and hits the ball off his pads towards deep square leg
Bravo moves forward and punches a flat and fast delivery from off stump towards long-off
defended back to the bowler off the front foot with a straight bat
Nayar moves forward and outside the line of off stump and pushes the ball towards mid-on for  a single
Nayar tries to work the ball through the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pad outside the line of off stump
played off the pads through square leg

Afridi takes an excellent catch! Uthappa strides forward and lofts the ball high towards long-on, he's hit it pretty well and the ball looks like it may clear the boundary, Afridi's at long on and he moves towards his right, keeps his eyes on the ball and holds the catch about two feet inside the boundary, he makes sure that the momentum doesn't carry him over, there's a broad smile on his face for he's having a fantastic match
Nayar steps out and swings the ball through square leg for one
slog-swept through midwicket for a single

Uthappa's safe! Nayar pushes the ball to cover and calls for the quick single, Ojha fields and fires the throw back at Gilchrist who breaks the stumps, Uthappa is just safe, direct hit and he would have been out
Uthappa tries to sweep one down leg side and misses, Gilchirst doesn't collect and the batsmen run one
Uthappa leans forward and flicks towards midwicket

nicely struck! Nayar takes a step down and lofts the ball straight over the bowler with a lovely free swing of the bat, that was like a golf swing, the ball bounces once before going over the boundary
Nayar tries to drive but gets an inside edge on to his pad
Uthappa plays the paddle shot towards square leg
Nayar tries to hit through leg but gets a leading edge towards point
cut off the back foot, nearly from Gilchrist's gloves  for a single towards short third man

is that another missed stumping? Nayar charges Ojha and tries to loft down the ground, he misses and the ball hits the top of the pad and bounces awkwardly high past Gilchirst's right for a leg bye, that was too tough to collect
Nayar moves back and pushes a quicker ball off his pads for a single towards square leg
that's another googly outside off stump, Uthappa tries to cut but is late on the shot and gets an edge that nearly goes on to his stumps
that's too wide outside off stump and umpire Harper agrees
Uthappa moves across his stumps and plays a deft sweep towards short fine leg
Afridi bowls full and fast on middle stump, Nayar moves forward and drives towards long off
a bit too short and Uthappa rocks back and pulls hard but straight to the fielder at deep midwicket
Afridi bowls another googly, Uthappa leans forward to drive and inside-edges on to his pad
Uthappa moves on to the front foot and pushes the ball towards long on for a single
Uthappa moves back and across and paddles the ball towards short third man
Uthappa moves back and cuts a flat ball outside off stump towards Rao at short third man, he fumbles and allows the single
Uthappa tries to open the face and run the ball towards third man but misses
Uthappa moves back and across and defends a flat and fast ball back to the bowler
Nayar moves across his stumps and flicks the ball off his pads behind square for  a single
Uthappa moves across his stumps and flicks the ball behind square, that went off his pad
defended towards the off side

lbw! Thornely moves back in his crease and Afridi fires in the faster googly, Thornely doesn't pick it and gets struck plumb in front of his stumps, that's out and Harper thinks for a moment before sending Thornely packing
beaten outside the off stump, Gilchirst whips off the bails but Thornely is safe

caught! Gilchrist will be relieved, Tendulkar charges Afridi and tries to loft the ball down the ground, there is a long off in place but the ball doesn't get that far, Tendulkar skies it high in the air and Silva runs towards mid-off from cover and takes a well-judged catch
bowled flat and straight on middle stump, Thornely moves back and defends to the bowler
played off the pads towards square leg for one more
cut off the back foot past point for a single, the fielder should have stopped that

missed stumping!, Tendulkar backs away to make room once again, he also comes out of his crease, Ojha shortens his length and beats Tendulkar's attempted loft over cover, Gilchirst fails to collect cleanly and allows Tendulkar to get back into his crease
this time he backs away to make room and smashes the ball past the bowler with a flat bat, the ball races to the long off boundary
Tendulkar moves around his crease as the bowler runs up, Ojha bowls flat and straight and Tendulkar defends on the off side
nudged off the pads towards square leg
Tendulkar tries to play the reverse sweep but doesn't connect properly and can't beat short third man
defended on the front foot towards the off side

Thornely moves back to a delivery on leg stump and nudges the ball off his pads past the wicketkeeper, Vijaykumar gives chase and crashes into the advertisement hoardings after he makes a desperate dive in vain
that's a bit short outside off stump, Tendulkar moves back and pushes the ball gently into the gap at cover
tossed up outside off stump, Thornely gets on to the front foot and drives through cover
defended back to the bowler on the front foot
good length on off stump, Tendulkar defends towards cover point off the front foot, Deccan have finished the Powerplay overs, Mumbai have scored 57 off the first six
short and wide outside off stump this time, Tendulkar reaches out for it and cuts the ball through cover for four more, that would have been wide if he had let it go too
that's a gift, a full ball on leg stump, Tendulkar leans forward and clips the ball off his pads to the deep backward square leg boundary, he can probably play that shot in his sleep
short of a length and wider outside off stump, Thornely moves back and runs the ball towards third man for a single
tight line and length on middle and off, Thornely waits in his crease and defends towards the off side
RP appeals for leg before but the ball pitched outside leg, Thornely had moved across his stumps to work the ball behind square but missed
full and wide down leg side, for some reason Thornely reaches out for it and dabs the ball towards fine leg, it would most certainly have been called wide if he had let it go
the slower full toss on middle and off, Zoysa was looking for the block hole, Tendulkar moves back initially and then opens the face of the bat to steer the ball past backward point
leg stump line from Zoysa, Thornely flicks the ball off his pads towards deep square leg for a single
good length on middle and off, the pace is slow from Zoysa, Thornely moves forward and defends towards cover
cut off the back foot towards point, Thornely made room by backing away towards leg
the slower ball on middle stump, Tendulkar leans forward and defends back past the bowler
RP pitches the ball short of a length and slants it across Thornely who waits on the back foot and tries to cut, he gets beaten by the bounce

good length delivery on middle and off, Tendulkar tries to turn the ball towards leg but gets a bit of a leading edge towards mid-off, Tendulkar sees that the fielder is deep in the circle and scurries through for the single
that's a terrible ball, too full on leg stump, Tendulkar moves forward and across and flicks firmly through midwicket, Silva can only admire the shot this time
good length and length just outside off stump, Tendulkar strides forward and defends with a straight bat
too full on leg stump, Tendulkar moves across and plays a superbly-timed flick towards midwicket where Silva dives to cut off the boundary
Tendulkar moves across his stumps to a good length ball and defends back to the bowler
bowled flat and fast on middle stump, defended towards the leg side on the back foot

he's gone! Rao's done it and the crowd comes to life! Jayasuriya gets down on one knee and sweeps another leg-stump delivery, he's hit it in the air and squarer this time, RP Singh is on the deep square leg boundary and the ball goes straight to him, he takes a flat catch and an extremely important one
Rao hasn't learnt, he continues to pitch outside leg stump and Jayasuriya once again sweeps along the ground past the man at short fine leg, Zoysa is in that position
leg stump line and Jayasuriya moves across and sweeps powerfully past short fine leg for four, poor line
there's an appeal for lbw but it pitched outside leg, Jayasuriya shuffled across his stump and got hit on the pad after missing the flick
Tendulkar strides forward to a full length ball and drives towards long-on, he runs towards the best seat in the house to watch Jayasuriya's brilliance

he's creamed that through square leg, short of a length once again and Jayasuriya moves back and across and pulls the ball hard and flat through square leg, his front foot was in the air as he played that, what a start this is for Mumbai, if this were the Wankhede they'd be screaming "Suriya, Suriya!"
short of a length delivery angling into the left-hander, Jayasuriya moves back an defends on the off side
super Sanath! Zoysa bowls another short ball but Jayasuriya is ready for it, he swivels on to the back foot and pulls the ball far over the fine leg boundary, he's punishing his fellow  Sri Lankan
this time Jayasuriya gets on top of the bounce of the short ball and pulls the ball along the ground in front of the fielder at deep backward square leg for four more

mis-hit but it's four! Zoysa tests Jayasuriya with the short ball, Jayasuriya tries to pull but gets a top edge that falls safely at fine leg and goes for four, there's no fine leg, just a fielder at deep backward square
Tendulkar strides forward to a good length ball that angles across him and drives towards mid-off
good length delivery on middle and off, Jayasuriya defends off the back foot
bang! Too full on leg stump, Jayasuriya moves forward and lifts the ball off his pads over deep midwicket for his 19th six of the tournament, he'll hit you there all day if you bowl that length
good length once again, on middle and off stump, Jayasuriya has no room to work with and defends on the front foot towards cover
a good length ball pitches outside off stump and swings into Jayasuriya  who strides forward and defends back to the bowler, the umpire has a word with Vijaykumar for running on the pitch
better line and length, angling into the left-hander, Jayasuriya leans forward and defends on the leg side
Vijaykumar strays down leg side again, Jayasuriya shuffles across to play the leg glance but misses, wide called
Vijaykumar pitches outside leg stump and angles the ball into Jayasuriya's hips, he moves across and nudges the ball towards the fine leg boundary, he's begun where he left off in  Mumbai
full ball on middle and leg, flicked off the pads to Thornely at deep square leg, Mumbai Indians complete a comfortable victory by 25 runs
length delivery outside off stump, RP makes room and tries to hit over cover, he gets an outside edge down to third man
Nehra fires one into the blockhole, Zoysa tries to swing through the leg side but doesn't connect properly
driven hard and straight past the bowler for a single
full ball on leg stump, Zoysa tries to flick but misses and gets hit on the pad, the ball goes towards the keeper
dropped, a full toss outside off stump, RP tries to hit over cover but mis-times it, Jayasuriya runs to his left and dives but floors the catch
Zoysa moves his front foot out of the way and drives the ball powerfully towards wide long-off where Uthappa dives and saves the boundary

Das is run out! He backs away towards leg side and Fernando follows him with a bouncer, Das gets beaten and is late in responding to Zoysa's call to steal a bye, Takawale hits the stumps direct at the bowler's end and Das is a long way short
Zoysa tries to hit across the line and mis-times the pull towards midwicket
Zoysa chips the ball in the gap over the fielder at midwicket for a four
Zoysa hits the ball in the air towards wide third man where shah runs across the boudnary and catches the ball just before he goes outside the boundary, he throws the ball back in time
driven off the back foot towards extra cover for  single
good length delivery outside off stump, Das defends off the back foot towards point
that's very wide outside off stump, Das swings wildly and gets beaten
banged in short outside off stump, the batsman sways out of the way

bowled! That's another high full toss, Teja backs away towards leg and swings, he misses and Bravo hits the top of middle stump, he's thrilled for he's having a superb match before catching his flight back to the West Indies tonight
the slower ball bowled full on middle stump, Teja moves forward and swings the ball over deep midwicket with a free and full swing of his bat, he slapped that and slapped hard

Rao's gone and with it so have Decccan's slim hopes! Rao slashes at a ball that's a bit too far away from him, he slices the ball in the air over point, Shah pedals backwards and manages to hold on to the catch although he didn't get into a very good position
driven firmly down the ground to long on for a single
full ball outside off stump, Rao gets beaten

Bravo is simply sensational! Rao lofts the ball high inside out over cover, that ball is going to clear the boundary but Bravo runs backwards at full tilt and takes the catch as it's going over the boundary, unfortunately he steps over the line and releases the ball too late, he then proceeds to dive acrobatically over the ad hoardings, stupendous effort

that's a high full toss, and a very fast one as well, Teja moved to the leg side and Fernando followed him with the high full toss, Teja does well to fend the ball towards the leg side, that's a no ball
Teja's pulled the ball into the first tier! He moves across, gets under a short ball and pulls the ball into the stands at long-leg, lovely timing
another slower ball angles into Rao and beats his attempted pull, the ball smacks him in the mid-riff and takes the wind out of him
the slower ball outside off stump, Rao has a wild swing but misses
that's lucky! Teja tries to play the hook but gets a top edge that flies high and far over the wicketkeeper's head, the ball bounces just inside the boundary
Teja moves his front foot out of the way to make room and tries to tee off down the ground, he gets beaten and Takawale collects
Rao reaches 50, well played! He gets there by top-edging an attempted pull towards third man, he didn't have enough room for the shot
the slower ball, Teja drops it on the leg side with soft hands and sprints the single, Bravo tries to kick the ball on to the stumps but misses
Rao moves towards the leg side to make room and cuts the ball hard through cover point, the ball is hurtling towards the boudnary but Thornely cuts it off
Teja moves across his stumps and tries to pull a short of a length delivery over long leg, he mis-hits it and the ball falls just outside the circle
full and wide outside off stump, Rao tries to drive the ball through cover but gets beaten
that's a home run! Rao stands his ground and whacks a short of a length delivery over deep midwicket with a baseball-type pull shot, such power in the stroke
full ball wide outside off stump, Rao tries to reach it but can't
dropped! Short of a length delivery and Teja tries to pull, he gets  a top-edge that lobs towards midwicket, Tendulkar runs in and dives, he just about gets his hands to it but can't hold on
Rao stays in his crease, waits for a good length ball to angle across him and opens the face to run the ball towards third man
full length on middle stump, Rao moves his front foot out of the way, gets under the ball and clobbers the ball miles over deep midwicket, he's getting a move on
good length delivery on middle stump, nudged off the back foot through midwicket
Rao backs away to make room and opens the face of the bat to run the ball fine past the fielder at short third man for more
Teja moves back and across and pushes the ball behind point for one more, they need more than that
short of a length just outside off stump, Rao runs the ball off the back foot towards third man
the slower ball on middle and leg, Rao moves across and works the ball off his pads behind square
Teja moves forward and pushes the ball off his pads towards midwicket for one
full and fast outside off stump, Teja squeezes the ball towards short third man for one
short ball on middle and leg, Rao pulls off the back foot towards long leg for one
driven back to the bowler on the front foot
Rao makes room by moving towards leg and drives a quicker ball through cover point for four more
quicker full toss, Rao hits hit hard an back to the bowler
Rao steps out of his crease and backs away to make room ,he swings his bat hard and lofts a flighted ball inside out over extra cover for four
driven off the front foot towards mid-off

terrific shot, Teja strides forward and picks up a length ball and lofts straight through the line, it's more of a punchy lofted drive and the ball clears the straight boundary for the first six of the innings
Teja moves forward and across and swats a shorter ball powerfully through midwicket for four, they need a lot more of these
Teja tries to drive on the up through cover but gets beaten
super ball, Nayar bowls a quicker ball that pitches on middle and straightens off the pitch and beats the outside edge
defended off the front foot towards cover, Nayar's keeping it tight on off stump
Teja tries to sweep but gets a top edge that lobs in the air but short of Tendulkar at short fine leg
driven off the front foot towards mid-off
Rao waits for the ball to angle into off stump and opens the face to run the ball towards short third man
Teja leans forward and closes the face to work the ball from off stump behind square on the leg side
Teja strides forward and defends a slow ball from off stump towards point
bowled slowly through the air on off, defended on the front foot
Teja moves across  his stumps and nudges the ball towards third man, this run-chase is going no-where I'm afraid
tight wicket to wicket line from Nayar, Teja defends from his crease to the leg side
played off the front foot behind point with an open face
pushed off the back foot towards cover for  a risky single, had there been a direct hit at the bowler's end Teja would have been out, Jayasuriya was the fielder and he got to the ball quickly
good length delivery angling into off and middle, defended on the front foot towards the off side

caught! Nayar's struck, Silva comes forward and tries to drive a good length ball that pitches around off stump and seams a fraction away from the right-hander, the ball goes past the outside edge and Takawale appeals for the catch, not too sure if there was an edge but Doctrove raises the finger

Silva drops the ball with soft hands close on the off side and calls Rao through for the single, Thornely runs quickly to the ball and hits the stumps at the batsman's end with an under throw, Rao is safe
pushed off the front foot towards midwicket for  a single
good length ball angling into the right-hander, nudged off the front foot behind square for one
Rao backs away to make room and dabs a good length ball which angles into him with an open face towards third man
lovely shot, Rao backs away to make room and drives a full ball inside out through cover for four
he takes the pace off the ball and bowls on a good length outside off, Rao drives off the front foot to cover
good length delivery angling into middle stump, pushed off the front foot towards long-on
defended back to the bowler off the front foot
a good length delivery pitches outside off and nips back sharply into the right-hander, Rao cuts towards Uthappa at point who hits the stumps, Rao is safely in his crease
Silva moves across his stumps and flicks a good length ball through square leg for a single
good length delivery angles into the right-hander, pushed on the front foot towards the off side for a quick single
Silva tries to run a good length ball from outside off stump towards third man but misses, the umpire has given it byes but I think there was a thick edge that bounced off the keeper's gloves
excellent line and length on off stump, Rao moves forward and defends and wants the single, Fernando runs quickly towards the ball to prevent it
Rao once again moves forward and chips a fuller delivery through the gap at midwicket
fuller length on middle stump, Rao moves forward and across and flicks the ball firmly towards deep midwicket where Thornely runs to his left and slides to save the boundary
Silva strides forward and opens the face of the bat to steer the ball towards third man
Silva steps across his stumps and flicks a ball from leg stump towards the fine leg boundary, well struck
Fernando angles a good length ball into middle stump, Rao moves forward and nudges the ball through midwicket
short and wide outside off stump, Silva stands tall on the back foot and lashes the ball through cover point for four, he struck that with immense power
Silva strides forward to drive but gets beaten once again outside off stump
short of a length outside off stump at a nippy pace, Silva cuts off the back foot and plays the ball to point
Silva tries to drive on the up and gets beaten by a good length ball that seams away from him
short and wide outside off stump, Silva moves back in his crease and cuts past the fielder at short third man for four, that hit near the toe end of the bat and went finer than Silva wanted
extremely wide outside off stump, Silva lets it go, this is Silva's first game of the IPL
Silva pushes the ball towards point and sets off for the run, Rao sends him back, Uthappa hits the stumps direct but Silva is back
fuller length on middle and leg, Silva moves across his stumps and flicks the ball towards long leg
short of a length on off and middle stump, Rao nudges the ball towards midwicket and sets off for the single, he gets into a tangle with Fernando as the bowler rushes towards the ball
pitches outside off stump and seams away from the right-hander, that's a bit too wide
defended off the front foot with an open face towards point

Sharma's lbw! Fernando goes over the wicket and delivers a perfectly-pitched slower ball that angles into the right-hander, Sharma tries to flick but is extremely early on the shot, he's nearly completed the stroke by the time the ball reaches him, seams a touch away from the right-hander, and thuds into his pads plumb in front of middle stump

caught! Deccan have taken a body blow! Fernando pitches short of a length and angles the ball into the left-hander, cramping Gilchrist for room, he tries to play the upper cut over backward point but only succeeds in offering a simple catch to Pinal Shah who runs in from third man and makes no mistake
he starts off with a slower ball that angles into the left-hander and straightens off the pitch, Gilchirst pushes off the front foot and gets beaten
Bravo angles the ball into the right-hander, pitches on a good length and begins to seam the ball away, Sharma moves forward and gets slightly squared up as he defends towards the bowler
excellent ball, Bravo pitches on a good length just outside off and nips the ball back into Sharma who fends off the back foot and gets beaten
Gilchirst gets cramped for room on the back foot by a short of a length ball that hurries on to him, he takes one hand off the bat and pushes the ball towards square leg
a good length ball jags back into the right-hander, Sharma waits on the back foot and nudges towards square leg
Sharma charges Bravo and tries to pull, Bravo follows him with a good length ball and cramps him for room
excellent ball, Bravo pitches on a good length outside off stump, Sharma gets drawn into the front-foot drive through the off side and the ball seams past his outside edge
whoops I spoke too soon, Gilchirst strides forward and tees off, swinging his bat like a golf club and lofting Nehra through the line right back over his head
short of a length delivery on off stump, Gilchrist defends off the back foot towards the bowler, Nehra's doing a fabulous job of keeping Gilchrist quiet
pitches on a good length and slants the ball cross the right-hander, Sharma stays in his crease and cuts the ball to third man
Sharma moves forward and across and mis-times the drive off a good length ball that angles across him towards mid-off
a fuller ball swings a shade away from Gilchrist who moves forward and drives the ball towards the off side
Nehra keeps the ball on a good length outside off stump, Gilchirst moves back and lets it go
tight line and length on off and middle stump, Sharma strides forward and defends back to the bowler
too short on middle and leg, Sharma moves across his stumps and pulls the ball down to the vacant long leg boundary, he picked up the length very early
Gilchrist waits on the back foot and slices a short of a length ball towards third man
pushed off the back foot towards cover

caught! What a catch by Thornely, Afridi tries to hit a six off his first ball and throws his bat at a good length ball outside off stump, he slices the ball high in the air, it's gone miles, Thornely runs backwards from around cover point, keeps his eyes fixed on the ball and takes an exceptional catch while on the run
good length ball on middle stump, Gilchirst strides forward and nudges the ball towards midwicket
full ball wide outside off stump, that;s the first extra of the innings

dropped, Gilchrist tries to loft over the leg side and ends up chipping the ball high in the air, he stopped his shot and didn't go through with it, Raje pedals backwards from mid-on and fails to hold on to the catch even though he got into position and got both hands to it
tight line and length outside off once again, Gilchirst lets it go through to Takawale
that's lucky, Gilchirst tries to push off the front foot towards the off side, he gets an inside edge that runs past his stumps towards the fine leg boundary
